name: LMSubs
description: OpenAI-compatible ASR (speech-to-text) + LLM subtitle translation. Works like OpenSubtitles: search and download 'LM Subtitles' in the Edit Subtitles dialog; the server generates the full subtitle, which Jellyfin then saves and registers. Provider presets plus configurable Base URL / API Key / Model. Completed results are cached. No web modification.
overview: ASR transcription + LLM subtitle translation (OpenSubtitles-style download flow)

versions.changelog: Settings page: Advanced section single column; clearer translation-toggle label.
OpenSubtitles-style flow: generate via Edit Subtitles -> search -> download; full sequential generation; removed injected tracks and playback-event triggers; REST API retained.
